detections.title: Sudo Command On Credential Or Sudoers Files
detections.description:
A user ran a command via sudo whose command line references /etc/shadow, /etc/gshadow or the sudoers
configuration (/etc/sudoers, /etc/sudoers.d/, visudo). Reading shadow files exposes password hashes;
changing sudoers grants persistent root rights.
Source data: sudo's own syslog line ("<user> : ... USER=<target> ; COMMAND=<cmd>"), normalized by the
Cribl pipeline. Required fields: event_type, action, user, target_user, command.
sudo logs the command it authorized, not what the process did afterwards. Commands run inside a root
shell (sudo -s / sudo -i) are NOT visible here; that needs sudo I/O logging or auditd execve events.
detections.logic:
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: sudo
    action: success
  sensitive_target:
    command|contains:
      - /etc/shadow
      - /etc/gshadow
      - /etc/sudoers
      - visudo
  condition: selection and sensitive_target
falsePositives: Administrators intentionally editing sudoers with visudo
Configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) templating sudoers files
detections.spl: index="homelab_auth" sourcetype="homelab:auth" event_type="sudo" action="success" command IN ("*/etc/shadow*", "*/etc/gshadow*", "*/etc/sudoers*", "*visudo*") | table event_time,user,target_user,command,dest
detections.savedSearch: Sigma - Sudo Command On Credential Or Sudoers Files

detections.title: SSH Authentication Failure
detections.description:
A single failed SSH authentication (wrong password, unknown user, rejected key) on a Linux host.
Building block for the password-guessing correlation below; on its own it is low severity because
mistyped passwords are common.
Source data: sshd syslog lines ("Failed password ...", "Invalid user ...") normalized by the Cribl
pipeline homelab_auth_normalize (docs/data-schema.md). Required fields: event_type, service, action, src, user.
detections.logic:
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: authentication
    service: ssh
    action: failure
  condition: selection
falsePositives: Monitoring or automation with outdated credentials

detections.title: SSH Password Guessing From Single Source
detections.description:
Three or more failed SSH authentications from the same source address within 5 minutes.
Mirrors the existing Splunk alert "HomeLab - Repeated Failed Logins".
detections.logic:
correlation:
  type: event_count
  rules:
    - ssh_auth_failure
  group-by:
    - src
  timespan: 5m
  generate: true
  condition:
    gte: 3
falsePositives: A user retrying a forgotten password several times
Vulnerability scanners in the lab network
detections.spl:
index="homelab_auth" sourcetype="homelab:auth" event_type="authentication" service="ssh" action="failure"

| bin _time span=5m
| stats count as event_count by _time src

| search event_count >= 3
detections.savedSearch: Sigma - SSH Password Guessing From Single Source

detections.title: Local User Account Created
detections.description:
A new local user account was created on a Linux host.
Source data: the shadow-utils syslog line "useradd[pid]: new user: name=<name>, UID=..." (also written when
Debian/Ubuntu adduser calls useradd), normalized by the Cribl pipeline to event_type=user_created.
Required fields: event_type, target_user, dest. The "new group" line written in the same call is not a match.
Accounts added by editing /etc/passwd directly or by tools that bypass useradd are NOT detected; that needs
auditd file watches on /etc/passwd.
detections.logic:
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: user_created
  condition: selection
